description: Cross-language golden vectors for the terminal history batch encoding shared by src/terminalHistory.ts and src-tauri/src/session/history.rs. Each vector is one independent batch: u32 LE record count, then per record [varint absLine delta from the previous record (batch starts at 0), varint timeMs delta from the previous record (batch starts at 0), u16 LE utf8 text byte length + bytes, u16 LE run count, then per run five varints: start, len, fg, bg, flags]. absLine must strictly increase within a batch and timeMs must not decrease; encoders reject anything else (see delta-reject). fg/bg are 32-bit packed colors, 0xFFFFFFFF = default. flags bits: 1 bold, 2 dim, 4 italic, 8 underline, 16 blink, 32 inverse, 64 invisible, 128 strike.
